title: Key beside an emoji, read as a byte stream
summary: A key following a four-byte emoji, fed to a byte stream split inside the emoji.
rationale: A UTF-8 byte stream may be cut inside a multibyte sequence; the valid input and its batch reading are unchanged.

expectation.rationale: Project policy of this example: valid input chunked at any byte boundary keeps the credential.

notes: Worked example for the representation guide (ADR 0016). Synthetic; the policy stated here is an example, not a claim about any product.
